- Flutter 3.47.4 deprecates builder: Use scrollableBuilder instead.
- Flutter 3.47.4 deprecates hasRepeatedFlags: Use hasConflictingFlags instead.
- Flutter 3.47.4 deprecates reverseCurve: Use animationStyle instead.

- Flutter 3.47.4 deprecates curve: Use animationStyle instead.

- Flutter 3.47.4 deprecates isFocusable: Check if isFocused is null instead.
- Flutter 3.47.4 deprecates focusable: Use focused instead. Setting focused automatically set focusable.
